Definition: Farm income no longer covers household needs
Use when: Participant links new activity to money pressure
Example (paraphrased): Said milk price drop made them look for other income

Definition: Need to create a role for the next generation
Use when: Participant mentions children joining the business
Example (paraphrased): Wanted something for their daughter to run

Definition: Visitors in the area create a market
Use when: Participant describes customers or visitors as the reason
Example (paraphrased): Noticed walkers asking to buy eggs at the gate

Definition: Public funding makes the activity possible
Use when: Participant names a grant or scheme
Example (paraphrased): A diversification grant covered half the build cost

Definition: Delays or refusal from planning authorities
Use when: Participant describes planning as a hurdle
Example (paraphrased): Waited over a year for approval

Definition: Lacks skills needed for the new activity
Use when: Participant says they had to learn new skills

Definition: New activity smooths income across the year
Example (paraphrased): Holiday let income covers the quiet months

Definition: New activity adds pressure on time
Use when: Participant describes stress or long hours
Example (paraphrased): Now working seven days a week
